name: tiny-tempo
description: Mobile-first Phaser 4 game project (portrait, touch-first, Android as target platform)

scripts.build:release: SENTRY_UPLOAD=1 npm run build && node scripts/check-no-sourcemaps.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-strip-types' npx cap sync android && node scripts/check-android-config.mjs
scripts.android:sync:release: npm run build:release && NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-strip-types' npx cap sync android && node scripts/check-android-config.mjs --release
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && node scripts/build-android.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync:release && node scripts/build-android.mjs bundleRelease
